headline: A page that hands an agent its tools
A space and a project, in one call
Every claim it records starts untrusted
Five sentences become five cited steps
The agent asks. It cannot decide.
A person decides, on the product's own screen
Approved at this exact revision, so the tools change
It failed, on the placeholder the agent left behind
A bundle, a receipt, an archive, each with a hash
The skill a person signed off, pinned to r2
